instruction: I keep a monthly log of total expenses I made on Amazon in a SimpleNote note. Update it with this month's entry.
notes: Supervisor keeps a SimpleNote note logging monthly Amazon spend. Plan: get passwords, log into SimpleNote, search for the log note (known-id), show it to learn the entry format (found-note-format), log into Amazon, list orders to compute this month's (May 2023) total (found-expense-total), then append a new '- <month> => $<total>' line with add_content_to_note (note-updated); only the note content changes, matching the evaluation (one updated Note, other fields untouched). Login actions take username and password as API args; the token parameter is the login response (access_token), marked null in action_params, and static token-for/username-for facts tie each app to its own credential/token objects so the planner cannot cross-bind tokens. supervisor.complete_task takes no API args (no answer); its note/month parameters are non-API task records used to state the goal condition. Month and amount are discrete objects linked by static facts since numeric fluents are disallowed.

plan: (simple-note-add-content-to-note amazon-expense-log-note append entry-may-2023 simple-note-token may-2023 amount-may-2023-total)

api_issues: action 'simple-note-login': 'access_token' is not a parameter of simple_note.login (valid: ['password', 'username'])
action 'amazon-login': 'access_token' is not a parameter of amazon.login (valid: ['password', 'username'])
